description: This Java source file defines the AlarmActivity class for an Android app, which manages starting and stopping a repeating alarm service using AlarmManager and PendingIntent. It includes UI initialization, button click handlers, and alarm scheduling logic.

classes.name: AlarmActivity
classes.description: Main activity controlling alarm scheduling and UI interactions for starting/stopping a repeating alarm service.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up PendingIntent and AlarmManager, and assigns button click handlers.

methods.name: mStartAlarmListener
methods.description: Handles start button click; schedules a repeating alarm every 30 seconds and shows a toast notification.

methods.name: mStopAlarmListener
methods.description: Handles stop button click; cancels the scheduled alarm and shows a toast notification.
